name: context-handoff
description: Pauses at a context threshold, writes a handoff file, puts a continue prompt on the clipboard, and can start a fresh session from it.

threshold.title: Threshold (%)
threshold.description: Context window fill (percent) that triggers the handoff.

mode.title: After the handoff
mode.description: ask: show buttons; auto: /clear and continue at once; clipboard: only copy the prompt.

folder.title: Handoff folder
folder.description: Where handoff files are written, relative to the session's project root.
